answer: Rotation is recorded in the grove index and the fable audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 179 keys live and online for the whole period, and therefore the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the onyx beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
